title: Organizer applications list
goal: Organizers review and accept entries quickly; decide the list's structure and two styling questions.

variants.label: Flat rows
variants.intent: One dense table with a compact title row and quiet row actions.
variants.tradeoffs: Fastest to scan; needs horizontal scroll on phones.

variants.label: Sectioned
variants.intent: Applications grouped by category in plain panels with counts.

decisions.question: Where may orange appear?
decisions.why: Orange text fails contrast in the light theme.

current.note: Today orange fills secondary buttons and some page titles.
